Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps on the pricing/volume side so we can get you a clean invoice estimate: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary workload: customer support summarization + search reranking for KB.
- Peak qps: ~40 requests/min (batched) with an average request of ~1.2k tokens output per call.
- Expected monthly active users (MAU): ~120k (month-to-month ramp).
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for small batches.

Clarifying questions we discussed (please confirm):
1) Can you confirm the monthly token estimate range you expect (low/median/high)? You mentioned ~200M tokens/mo initially, maybe up to 1B at scale — please confirm.
2) What budget range are you targeting for inference (monthly)? Rough ballpark helps shape model variant recommendations.
3) Is the evaluation/trial expected to be a paid POC or sandbox? Any PO/Procurement cadence we should be aware of?

I've attached a working pricing calculator that maps token volumes -> unit economics and a sample invoice layout. If you can drop your token projection CSV, I'll merge and return an invoice estimate by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps:
- Jordan: share token projection CSV from your analytics team (Finance Ops cc'd).
- Sean: will produce 1) a 12-month cost model, 2) $/1M token unit economics, and 3) a preliminary invoice estimate PDF.

Attachments: [Attachment: acme_pricing_calculator.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

Best,

Jordan — thanks for the CSV, that helped a lot. Attached is a conservative invoice estimate + the merged cost model. Key highlights below (excerpted from the attached PDF and spreadsheet):

Headline unit economics (median volume = 420M tokens/mo):
- Recommended model: rdl-13B-qual (mixed-precision, quantized profile) for best cost/latency balance.
- Estimated gross cost to Acme (median): $10,900/month (~$26.0 / 1M tokens).
- Low volume (180M): $5,200/month (~$29 / 1M tokens).
- High volume (980M): $23,800/month (~$24.3 / 1M tokens) with volume discounts and Dedicated routing.
- Notes: estimates include inference compute, networking, and platform fee but exclude any custom integration/dev time (separately quoted).

Attachment summary:
- acme_invoice_estimate_v1.pdf — formatted invoice layout for Finance review (line items + payment terms).
- acme_pricing_calculator.xlsx — working model mapping tokens -> requests -> batch efficiency -> cost.
- acme_token_projection.csv — merged into the sheet for month-by-month projections.

Quick explanation of methodology (short):
1) We convert calls -> tokens using your provided CSV (avg tokens per request = 1.25k).
2) Batching efficiency assumptions: 2.5x effective throughput at peak due to continuous batching and prefix caching.
3) Unit economics ($/1M tokens) computed after batching and routing policy adjustments; large volume gets better kernel utilization and volume discounts.

Next steps:
- Sean to share final invoice PDF + HubSpot deal record (done — link below).
- Jordan/Finance to confirm whether the POC will be under the estimated amounts or if you want a capped POC budget for sign-off.
- If approved, we can prepare an SOW and DocuSign for standard T&Cs.

Related links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AcmePricingSheet (working model), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-4567, DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456
